_meta.title: Data Centre projects — announced / under-construction
_meta.description: India DC pipeline × kVA demand × GOEM coverage. Primary source: JLL India DC reports + operator IR decks + press announcements.
_meta.kvaFormula: 1 MW IT load → 1.4 MW DG backup (N+1 standard) → 1,400 kVA. gensetKvaEstimate = stated_MW_IT × 1400. Rounded to nearest 500.

rowSchema.scaleDescriptor: string — stated MW IT capacity or rack count
rowSchema.mwItLoad: number | null — stated MW IT load (null = estimated)
rowSchema.gensetKvaEstimate: number — kVA total DG backup installed (calculated or estimated)
rowSchema.awardedGoemId: string | null — GOEM who won (if known)
rowSchema.awardedMake: string | null — OEM genset supplier (if known)
rowSchema.koelOpportunity: open | unlikely | unknown — open = not yet awarded, specs not locked
rowSchema.notes: string | null — action note for KOEL/GOEM

projects.scaleDescriptor: 30 MW IT load per phase (Phase 1 + Phase 2), 400+ MW campus planned
projects.source: Yotta Data Services press releases; JLL India Data Centre Report 2024
projects.notes: NM1 + NM2 commissioned and live. OEM supplier not publicly disclosed. Kala covers Maharashtra. NM3 (next phase) is the active specification opportunity — see separate entry.

projects.scaleDescriptor: 30 MW IT load, Phase 3; procurement stage as of H1 2025
projects.source: Yotta IR 2024-25; ET Tech; CBRE India DC Report Q3 2024
projects.notes: Genset OEM not announced. KOEL Optiprime 12,500 kVA twin-pack is spec-compatible for N+1 configuration (3–4 sets). Action: Kala to push KOEL at engineering / EPC consultant stage before spec locks.

projects.developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC)
projects.scaleDescriptor: ~30 MW IT load; expansion of Chandivali campus
projects.source: STT GDC India press releases; CBRE India Q4 2024; datacentermap.com
projects.notes: Singapore-headquartered STT GDC does not have a globally standardised genset OEM — India procurement is project-by-project. Kala covers Maharashtra. This is a winnable bid for KOEL Optiprime if pushed at EPC stage.

projects.scaleDescriptor: 50 MW IT load Phase 1; 1 GW campus announced long-term
projects.source: Adani Enterprises investor day Dec 2023; Mint; The Hindu BusinessLine
projects.notes: Joint venture brings EdgeConneX's US hyperscale design templates — likely to follow US spec preferences (CAT/Cummins). However, Phase 1 procurement is India-managed and EPC consultant not named. Early engagement recommended via Kala + KOEL HO DC vertical.

projects.developer: Web Werks India (acquired by NTT in 2022)
projects.scaleDescriptor: 20 MW IT load; NAP facility expansion
projects.source: NTT India press release (post-acquisition); JLL India DC 2024
projects.notes: Post-NTT acquisition, procurement may shift to NTT's global standards. But India operations remain semi-autonomous. Smaller scale (28,000 kVA) is well within KOEL's range without Optiprime. Action: Kala to verify current genset OEM and flag replacement cycle.

projects.scaleDescriptor: ~30 MW IT load expansion; part of ₹3 lakh crore India investment plan
projects.source: Microsoft India blog Jan 2025; ET Tech; CBRE
projects.notes: Microsoft globally standardises on Cummins and CAT for DG. India is unlikely to deviate. Marked unlikely for KOEL. Worth tracking for Phase 2+ or service contract opportunity once commissioned.

projects.scaleDescriptor: Phase 4 expansion; currently 10,000+ rack facility, expanding to 12,000+
projects.source: CtrlS press releases; Dataquest India; JLL India DC 2024
projects.notes: CtrlS is a domestic operator with India-centric procurement — no global OEM preference. Sunbeam covers Telangana (Hyderabad). Existing genset OEM for HYD1 not publicly known. Phase 4 is a new spec — push Sunbeam to engage CtrlS engineering team. 35,000 kVA is achievable with KOEL's HHP range.

projects.scaleDescriptor: ~15 MW IT load expansion phase; pan-India expansion underway
projects.source: Nxtra Data investor presentation; Airtel AR FY25; JLL India DC 2024
projects.notes: Nxtra is rapidly expanding — 10+ DCs announced across India. Procurement is decentralized by facility. No disclosed global OEM lock-in. 21,000 kVA is mid-range — KOEL 2500 kVA or 3000 kVA sets (4–6 units N+1) are competitive. Sunbeam should engage Nxtra Hyderabad facility head.

projects.scaleDescriptor: 3 availability zones; hyperscale region (100+ MW estimated)
projects.source: AWS press release Nov 2022; JLL India DC 2024; industry sources
projects.notes: AWS globally uses CAT and Cummins. India region almost certainly follows global standard. Already commissioned — not a DG procurement opportunity. Tracked for market sizing only: 140,000 kVA illustrates KOEL's addressable total if it breaks hyperscale spec.

projects.scaleDescriptor: ~30 MW IT load total (NDC1 + NDC2 combined); NDC3 being planned
projects.source: NTT India press releases; JLL India DC 2023/24; datacentermap.com
projects.notes: NTT does not have a single global DG standard — procurement varies by region. India ops have used multiple OEMs. NDC3 Chennai expansion (planning stage) is the live opportunity. Sunbeam covers Tamil Nadu/Karnataka. Action: Sunbeam to engage NTT Netmagic facility operations for NDC3 engineering input.
